purpose: Assess Midas mobile/Atlas and official Midas-TradingView integration separately for strict G9 and provider-neutral ACCOUNT gates.

evidence: Midas officially advertises real-time U.S. market data free to its customers.

Midas support explicitly states TradingView market data is CBOE One while Midas has more comprehensive market-data licenses, proving the Midas app data path is distinct and broader than the TradingView path.
Midas publishes Nasdaq and NYSE subscriber/display agreements and acts as distributor/vendor for those agreements.

The Nasdaq subscriber agreement licenses non-professional/private subscriber information for personal use; no primary-source evidence found that grants the user's automated/non-display use required by strict G9-C.

The exact Midas mobile/Atlas product lineage has not yet been proven as consolidated UTP Tape-C/National NBBO, and the public Atlas query shapes reviewed expose last price/session state but no independent bid/ask event timestamps.

Atlas is now a live official Midas web product and explicitly offers free live market data and portfolio tracking, but its public product page does not document bid/ask/order-book lineage or an end-user API.

No public developer/API endpoint or developer portal for Midas was found in the current official product/support surfaces; Alpaca's March 2026 Midas case study still describes advanced-user API access as roadmap.
Official Midas-Matriks integration is BIST-only and therefore does not satisfy the NASDAQ account/G9 use case.
TradingView officially lists Midas as eligible to verify real-time NASDAQ, NYSE, AMEX/NYSE Arca and OTC exchange subscriptions from the connected broker account.
This proves exchange-level realtime entitlements exist on the Midas account, but exchange-level subscriptions do not by themselves prove a consolidated National NBBO across all protected venues.

The Midas-distributed Nasdaq subscriber agreement names Midas Menkul Değerler A.Ş. as distributor and licenses non-professional/private subscriber information for personal use; this is not explicit automated/non-display API permission.

Alpaca Broker API documentation states standard broker-partner equities plans are realtime IEX or 15-minute delayed SIP, while custom comprehensive market-data arrangements may be negotiated. Therefore Midas being an Alpaca partner does not prove its exact end-user feed is live SIP/NBBO.
midas_mobile_atlas_market_data.reopen_condition: Primary-source Midas/venue documentation identifies exact consolidated National NBBO/UTP lineage and explicitly permits the intended automated/non-display personal use, plus a sanctioned scheduler-callable quote path returns fresh bid+ask+last with independent event timestamps.
midas_mobile_atlas_market_data.current_best_inference: Midas has genuine realtime exchange entitlements and may have custom partner data, but exact consolidated National NBBO lineage plus automated/non-display end-user rights remain unproven. Do not infer SIP/NBBO from 'realtime' branding or exchange verification alone.

evidence: Midas and TradingView officially support connecting a Midas brokerage account from TradingView's Trading Panel for U.S. equities.

TradingView's broker integration FAQ states a working /quotes implementation is needed for Sell/Buy fields, quote polling defaults to 500 ms and is capped at 1000 ms, and broker quote data is used in the order dialog.
TradingView quote schemas expose bid, ask and trade/last plus delayed-state metadata. This establishes a sanctioned broker-sourced bid/ask/last technical surface in the Midas integration.
TradingView's standard quote object does not expose independent bid-event, ask-event and trade-event timestamps required by strict G9-B; extended-session rtc_time is not an equivalent proof.

TradingView supports verifying Midas broker subscriptions for AMEX/NYSE Arca, NASDAQ, NYSE and OTC. These are exchange-specific entitlements and do not by themselves prove consolidated National NBBO/UTP lineage.

TradingView's Account/Broker integration exposes accounts, current balance/equity state and positions; its FAQ documents account-manager/balance/positions polling at sub-2-second intervals. This is technically sufficient in shape for the provider-neutral ACCOUNT gate.

No sanctioned end-user TradingView/Midas API or connector is callable from the canonical ChatGPT scheduler today; TradingView's REST Broker API is an integration interface for brokers rather than an end-user API.
midas_via_tradingview.account_reopen_condition: A sanctioned Midas or TradingView end-user connector/API becomes callable by the canonical scheduler, then fresh same-run account value/cash and equity positions/exposure both parse successfully without order actions.

evidence: Public community project is explicitly unofficial and states Midas has no public API.
It drives the Atlas web app session and reproduces internal GraphQL reads.
Its read path exposes portfolio value, cash/buying power and positions, which is technically sufficient in shape for ACCOUNT.
Its current public quote/snapshot path reviewed exposes last trade price/session status and OHLCV candles but no bid/ask quote-event timestamps required for strict G9.
Because it is not an official/sanctioned Midas integration, it is not eligible as canonical ACCOUNT authority.
Midas officially states U.S. brokerage activity is carried out through Alpaca Securities LLC.
Alpaca identifies Midas as an early and current Broker API partner.
Alpaca documents that full SIP uses CTA+UTP and can provide 100% U.S. market volume under entitled plans.
Current connected Alpaca tool surface exposes market-data quote/trade endpoints but no account/positions adapter.

Fresh 2026-10-03 connector probe: live feed=sip latest quote and latest trade both returned connector internal_error, while delayed_sip quote+trade succeeded and returned Tape C with independent quote/trade timestamps.
Weekend delayed_sip success proves delayed consolidated data callability only; it cannot establish live SIP entitlement or G9 freshness.
midas_alpaca_chain.reopen_condition: A sanctioned user-callable Midas/Alpaca path exposes current account state and/or live SIP quote+trade under the user's lawful entitlement; for G9 additionally require fresh RTH bid+ask+last and explicit automated/non-display permission.

atlas.evidence: Official Midas Atlas page is live and states free live market data, portfolio tracking, BIST/US stocks and US options.

public_end_user_api.evidence: Alpaca March 2026 Midas case study describes API access for advanced users as part of the 2026-and-beyond roadmap; current official Midas search surfaces Atlas but no public developer/API product.

matriks.evidence: Official Midas Matriks support states Midas login is supported on Matriks platforms, but tradable products through this integration are Borsa Istanbul equities only.

realtime_exchange_entitlements.evidence: TradingView broker-subscription verification officially supports these exchanges for Midas accounts.
realtime_exchange_entitlements.strict_g9_implication: A remains UNPROVEN because exchange realtime entitlement does not establish consolidated National NBBO.

alpaca_partner_feed.evidence: Alpaca standard Broker API market-data subscriptions are realtime IEX or delayed SIP; custom comprehensive arrangements exist.
alpaca_partner_feed.strict_g9_implication: Do not assume live SIP/NBBO from partner status.

legal_entitlement.nasdaq: Midas-distributed Nasdaq participant agreement licenses nonprofessional/private subscriber information for personal use and prohibits redistribution/access by others; no explicit automated/non-display entitlement was found.
legal_entitlement.nyse: Midas-distributed NYSE agreement is a Market Data Display Services agreement for nonprofessional subscribers and limits permitted use to the subscriber's own individual use.
legal_entitlement.strict_g9_c_implication: Personal/display entitlement is not treated as proof of the explicit automated/non-display entitlement required by current strict G9-C.
